component.name: CeeDee Ripper
component.summary: Extract audio CDs to common music formats

description.p: CeeDee Ripper detects audio CDs, looks up album metadata, and extracts selected tracks to FLAC, MP3, WAV, or Ogg Vorbis files.
It supports MusicBrainz and GnuDB/CDDB metadata lookup, album art previews, selectable tracks, and configurable output folders.
Prepared local packaging metadata for desktop, Debian, Snap, and AppStream validation.
